answer: Each agent must lock a refundable bond before placing orders. If a signed delivery receipt contradicts its claim, arbitration can slash the stake. Reputation grows only through repeated, verified work, so an attacker cannot copy one history across a crowd of fake identities. Splitting capital among sybils means funding every bond separately; the attacker pays in scarce liquidity and risks losing each stake. A wharf, orchard, and pearl can serve as memorable names in the ledger, not substitutes for proof.
